sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The Employee Referral Policy encourages associates to refer qualified candidates from their network for open positions at Cotelligent. The policy is designed to leverage employee networks to attract quality talent while rewarding employees for successful referrals. This policy is applicable globally to all full-time employees of Cotelligent.

sections.title: Referral Bonus Structure — CRSG Positions
paragraphs: CRSG (Cotelligent Revenue Generating Staff) positions are client-billable roles. The referral bonus for CRSG positions is based on the level of the referred candidate's role: Entry Level / Junior: Rs. 15,000/-. Mid-Level: Rs. 25,000/-. Senior Level: Rs. 40,000/-. Lead / Manager Level: Rs. 60,000/-.
The referral bonus is paid in two tranches: 50% after the referred associate completes 3 months of service, and the remaining 50% after the referred associate completes 6 months of service.

sections.title: Referral Bonus Structure — Non-CRSG Positions
paragraphs: Non-CRSG positions include internal support functions (HR, Finance, Admin, IT, etc.). The referral bonus for Non-CRSG positions is: Entry Level / Junior: Rs. 8,000/-. Mid-Level: Rs. 15,000/-. Senior Level: Rs. 25,000/-.
The same two-tranche payment structure applies: 50% at 3 months and 50% at 6 months of the referred associate's service.

sections.title: Eligibility to Refer
paragraphs: All full-time permanent employees are eligible to participate in the referral program. Associates serving their notice period are NOT eligible to make referrals. Employees in HR and Talent Acquisition teams are not eligible for referral bonuses as sourcing candidates is part of their core job.
An associate cannot refer a candidate who has applied or been interviewed within the last 6 months through another channel. Former Cotelligent employees are not eligible as referrals.

sections.title: How to Submit a Referral
paragraphs: Associates must submit referrals through the official referral portal or by emailing the Talent Acquisition team with the candidate's resume and the position being referred for. Self-referrals are not permitted — you cannot refer yourself.
The referral must be submitted before the candidate applies through any other channel. If a candidate has already applied independently, the referral will not be eligible for a bonus.

sections.title: Terms and Conditions
paragraphs: The referral bonus is taxable as per applicable Indian income tax laws and will be added to the referring employee's salary for tax computation. The bonus is payable only if both the referring employee and the referred associate are actively employed with Cotelligent at the time of each tranche payment.

Cotelligent reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the referral program at any time. Decisions regarding candidate selection and offer are solely at Cotelligent's discretion and are not influenced by the referral.
